name: a long action is worked in capped sessions around a commitment, then the next project follows
why: The projected day must be the current policy replayed forward: the maximum-session cap splits the report action into sessions of its risk-adjusted effort, the commitment interrupts it where the schedule says, a full session owes its maximum-session break (ranking-consistency), during which the lower-value project's own action fills the time instead, and the report action resumes once its own session is done and the day closes at the daily horizon. A changed line here means the replayed policy moved.
